liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Jerry wakes up for a brilliant performance of this song; Arguably the lousiest version performed until about 1992, despite a magnificent audio recording [11][17][18][20]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jerry delivers a blazing performance, returning with more energy after the break; First set is just okay, featuring a good version of this song [12][13]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Certain songs stuck in the listener's mind after decades [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Favorite second set sequence includes a seamless transition to a telepathic Other One [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-20.aud.claridge.wise.312.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1979-01-20.nak700.moore.bertha.100025.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min; rated 3.94/5 by 18 [2]
- **gd79-01-20.naks.moore.12575.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 3.71/5 by 21 [3]. Said about its sound: Amazingly clear sound, though vocals are quiet at times [20]
- **gd1979-01-20.110977.nak700-moore.berger.flac24**: audience recording; 21 songs; 166 min [4]

## Around the show

- Jerry sounds tired; Donna missing; audience shouts for Truckin' opener or encore [11]
- Band adjusts to no backing vocals after Donna's departure [12]
- Freezing cold Saturday night in Buffalo; balcony seat felt right on top of band [14]
- No Donna tonight; first set features a fragilly pleasing Promised Land [15]
- Show started almost two hours late; tape flips during Good Lovin' and drums transition [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-20.aud.claridge.wise.312.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Eddie Claridge; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Sony ECM-280 mics > Sony tc158 > FOB Cass. Master [1]
- **gd1979-01-20.nak700.moore.bertha.100025.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Charlie Miller and Jay Ashley; source: (FOB/6th Row) Nakamichi 700 (Sony D5/Dolby B) -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> FLAC [2]. Also: Remaster completed in 2009 using Bertha Digital Audio Workstation and proprietary restoration processes [2]
- **gd79-01-20.naks.moore.12575.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen, Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: NAK 700's [3]. Also: NAKs and Sony TC-D5M used during DAT conversion, not original 1979 recording [9]
- **gd1979-01-20.110977.nak700-moore.berger.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jerry Moore from 6th row center; [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster - Shea's Buffalo Theatre](https://www.dead.net/archives/1979/artwork/poster-sheas-buffalo-theatre) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shea's Buffalo Theatre - January 20, 1979](https://www.dead.net/show/january-20-1979) [23]
- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-01-20 Shea's Buffalo Theater, Buffalo, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-01-20-sheas-buffalo-theater-buffalo-ny-usa/) [24]
